ablation_cd.json.description: Controlled 4-way system ablation on Synthetic MoE under 24MB RAM budget (Baseline LRU, KAEF alone, Loom+LRU, Loom+KAEF).

ember_diagnostic.json.description: Root cause diagnostic of online SVD construction overhead on the host CPU.

ember_usefulness.json.description: Measurements of low-rank SVD sketch sizes, RAM residency, and provisional draft speedups.

m2_correctness_determinism.json.description: Verification of deterministic forward equivalence (Delta L2 = 0.0, cosine similarity = 1.0) across tested SIMD kernels and quantization schemes.

m3_real_moe_benchmarks.json.description: Primary real MoE benchmark measurements (OLMoE-1B-7B and Synthetic MoE) under cgroup memory constraints, documenting TTFT, throughput, and I/O stalls.

m4_regime_maps.json.description: Storage traffic (MB/token) and storage amplification sweeps across RAM budgets, verifying Loom and KAEF I/O reductions.

m5_ablations.json.description: Factorial subsystem ablations and microarchitectural overhead decompositions.

m6_ember_gate.json.description: Ember decision gate evaluation across Modes A, B, and C, unassisted TTFT degradation, draft preview latency, and relative L2 divergence.

m7_reliability_security.json.description: Stress testing, OOM stability, and memory limit adherence over long context sequences.

overhead_breakdown.json.description: Nanosecond-resolution profiling of KAEF planning latency, decomposing synchronous arena re-allocation from algorithmic search.

ram_sweep.json.description: Full capacity sweep across 7 memory allocations (16MB to 256MB), documenting non-monotonic inversion regimes and intermediate regressions.
